brief.t: First: protect today’s facility move. Michigan Office Movers says the move deposit card was declined and needs a replacement card; they also need a yes/no on the hi-lo at origin. This is a same-day operational stop, not inbox cleanup.
Natugeda requested an immediate production-status and estimated-timeline update in WhatsApp last night. Give a verified status today; no production or ship date without operations confirmation.

Ashley / Earth and Ash is waiting on the paper-label sample-to-print process for three products. Laura also said the invoice would go out; payment remains unconfirmed. Answer the label workflow and confirm invoice/payment before any purchase promise.

Chris, an Australian brand, asked overnight whether PLL makes sporting balms and creams and requested a call. Qualify product scope, target volume, U.S. launch timing, and regulatory needs before scheduling.

The new facility move is now a direct revenue-risk constraint: customer commitments must be checked against actual production capacity and material access today. Do not promise dates while the move and equipment plan are unresolved.

Ephix has a current 10,000-jar quote at an average delivered unit price of $0.608 to the new Farmington Hills address. A W-9 and sales-tax exemption are still required to remove tax; decide release only after documents and approval are in hand.

CRM remains an accountability blocker: the most recent captured dashboard showed 11 tasks, 8 overdue, and an open customer-page Assign To defect. Live re-verification is blocked because the browser session is logged out; do not mark either condition resolved.

kb.a: Michigan Office Movers reported on July 27 that the move-deposit card was declined and asked for a replacement card, plus confirmation whether a hi-lo will load product at origin. Treat both as same-day move blockers; no confirmation of resolution exists.

Natugeda asked in WhatsApp on July 27 for production status and an estimated timeline as soon as possible. No verified current production stage or delivery date is available; operations must confirm before replying.

Ashley selected paper labels for the three Earth and Ash products and needs the sample-to-print process for an outside partner. Laura said an invoice would be sent for the Miron packaging, but payment is not confirmed; keep label timing conditional on artwork approval and printer lead time.

Chris submitted a Shopify contact form overnight asking whether PLL makes sporting balms and creams for an Australian brand expanding into the U.S. Qualify products, units, launch timing, and regulatory requirements before scheduling a call or promising capability.

Stephen Gould quoted 10,000 Ephix giveaway jars delivered to the new address at an average $0.608 per unit. A W-9 and sales-tax exemption form are required to remove tax from the final invoice; release is not confirmed.

Obelis quoted EU PIF review at €310 per product and CPSR creation at €360 per product, with a standard six-week timeline, for the Lip Oil and Dry Shampoo request. They need PLL’s company name, address, and VAT/tax ID for an official quote; no purchase approval is recorded.

Victor’s existing task is due July 31. The latest authoritative update remains that PLL contacted him and he will verify compatibility of his packaging components with the Edge Control formula; final quote inputs are still not verified.

The last confirmed Terra Lotus direction is that Kenna needs cleanser and oil-cleanser support. The previously proposed Monday call time never became confirmed evidence; do not present it as scheduled.

The last captured CRM dashboard showed 11 tasks and 8 overdue. CRM Development / Issues most recently repeated that customer-page task creation lacks a usable Assign To list. The live CRM browser session is currently logged out, so those conditions require fresh authenticated verification.

Today’s operating lane is move continuity first, then verified customer production communication, then payment/label and new-lead qualification. Protect existing commitments; do not turn unverified emails or chat requests into promised dates or pricing.
